sources.note: Main company website. Describes EHL as leader in integrated healthcare IT, serving hospitals, physician practices, health plans, pharmacies. Lists broad product portfolio including CARE hospital system, Phoenix EHR, Eternity managed care, eLab, eRad, eBilling, clearinghouse, analytics, telehealth, HIE.
Phoenix EHR product page. Describes real-time documentation, pre-built/customizable templates, patient flow management, clinical decision support for quality measures and disease management.
Phoenix Oncology variant. Oncology-specific EHR for practice and hospital-based oncology, interfaces with hospital registration and ancillary systems.
Phoenix Practice Management System page. High-level description of clinical, financial, operational, and corporate management. No feature details.
eBilling product page. Integrated payments and accounts receivable, claims editing, patient liability, account histories, EDI services.
E*Prescription page. Electronic prescribing to patient pharmacy, drug-drug interaction checking, duplicate medication detection, drug allergy verification, formulary status checking.
Patient Portal page. Electronic access to PHR, messaging, appointment scheduling, email notifications, file sharing, health library, video conferencing integration.
CARE Clinical Foundation hospital system page. Described as open repository for clinical information providing EHR/EMR management. Minimal detail on page.
About page. Describes EHL as multi-institutional R&D organization, connected health platform, integrated pharmaceutical and clinical solutions. Claims global operations (50+ countries listed).
Clearinghouse page. References EDI, EClaims, EScan for claims processing but minimal substantive detail on page.
